prompts.prompt: Create a completely NEW full-frame lower-wall material texture using the supplied image as the exact material reference, not a scene. Target square 2048 x 2048. This is the lower continuation directly BELOW the supplied approved red lime-plaster texture. The new image's entire TOP EDGE must continue the supplied image's BOTTOM EDGE unchanged in color, grain size, mottling and horizontal placement: no visible horizontal join when the two images are stacked. Match the reference's fine, low-contrast dusty salmon-red matte lime-plaster grain precisely. The first upper quarter must be visually identical in material and color to the bottom quarter of the reference, with no added weathering there. Only progressively LOWER DOWN introduce gentle darkening, fine dirt staining, sparse shallow worn spots and subtle vertical rain traces; darkest weathering near the bottom 15 percent, restrained realistic variation, no large exposed brick, no new cracks. The left and right edges must join seamlessly with each other at every height, including lower weathering. Vertical top-to-bottom tiling is NOT required: this is a directional lower-wall strip. Flat orthographic base-color texture over the entire canvas, no perspective, no objects, no borders, no text, no shadows, no highlights, no ambient occlusion, no directional lighting, no artificial surface pattern. Natural fine photographic plaster surface, not coarse carved relief. Preserve the exact upper material while letting only the lower section gradually age. This is a new complete asset, not a collage or a before-after pair.

Generate a NEW complete square 2048x2048 texture that is the downward continuation of this exact reference plaster. Very fine, quiet, nearly flat dusty pink-red limestone plaster, matching the supplied image's color and microscopic grain. The TOP half must look indistinguishable from the reference's BOTTOM half: match the actual fine matte surface, do not reinterpret it. Along the new TOP border continue the original BOTTOM border line-for-line, with exactly matching red tone and tiny grain; no horizontal line should be visible when placed immediately below the reference. In the BOTTOM quarter only, add a subtle gradual increase in damp dark red discoloration and slight pigment wear; texture grain remains as fine and low-contrast as in the original. Do NOT add raised ridges, embossed curls, worms, bubbles, coarse stucco, carving, embossed swirls, rocky relief or large pores. The previous attempt failed because its grain became larger and embossed: avoid that completely. All left/right border colors and wear must connect for horizontal tiling. This is a flat unlit photographic plaster albedo, with NO cast shadows, NO highlights, NO illumination change, NO vignette, NO border or text. The change downwards is pigment discoloration only. Do not reproduce the previous rejected image. One full new square asset with exact source-consistent upper material and gentle lower wear.

Create one NEW native 4:1 horizontal architectural PAINT texture, output canvas exactly 2048 x 512 pixels (width four times height). The supplied image is ONLY a reference for the muted cobalt-blue, jade-green and ochre-gold palette and traditional Chinese hexagonal floral motifs. Replace its raised relief with absolutely FLAT painted ornament: all color boundaries coplanar, NO bevels, carved depth, highlights, drop shadows, ambient occlusion, metallic shine or illumination gradient. Native 4:1 frame, NOT a 3:1 image squeezed afterward. Fill every pixel, no white/black borders or padding. Seamless repeat horizontally: exactly FOUR complete equally spaced hexagonal medallions across, alternating blue, green, blue, green with thin ochre-gold outlines and simple gold floral centers. Each medallion and intervening connector fits a repeat cell; left and right canvas boundaries cut through the identical midpoint of an inter-medallion connector, at the same color and vertical positions. The entire band is exactly TWO complete blue-green repeat periods, so the fourth green flows naturally into the first blue. Top and bottom are thin, flat, straight ochre-gold painted rules; they continue at the exact same height and color through the left/right join. Very subtle matte pigment wear only, continuous at the join, fine realistic painted surface, never chipping that creates a shadow. Frontal orthographic unlit base-color map, one single horizontal band, NOT two rows, NOT a room, NOT a beam in perspective. No text, logos or watermarks. Important deliverable constraints: native 2048x512 4:1 image; exact horizontal pattern continuity; flat matte paint with ZERO relief lighting.

Generate a completely new flat painted architectural texture. The actual OUTPUT IMAGE CANVAS must have width exactly FOUR times its height: 2048 pixels wide by 512 pixels high. Do NOT put a 4:1 strip inside a 3:1 canvas. NO white margins, NO letterbox bars, NO unused blank areas: paint fills the canvas edge to edge, including first and last pixel rows. Use the reference only for cobalt blue, jade green, ochre gold colors and traditional hexagonal floral pattern; remove ALL relief, shading, bevels, highlights, cast shadows and depth. Absolutely coplanar matte painted color shapes with subtle fine pigment texture. Exactly four full hexagonal medallions side by side, blue-green-blue-green, with gold floral centers and gold outlines. Four equal repeat cells. Place the cut at BOTH left and right edges in the center of the same BLUE connector area: identical vertical connector geometry and same colors across the wrap. Every horizontal rule reaches both edges at exactly matching heights. Whole number of repeat periods, no partial extra medallion. Thin flat gold painted lines along top/bottom borders at the image edges. One continuous horizontal band, NOT multiple rows, NOT a photograph of a physical beam, NOT a framed image. NATIVE 4:1 proportion is mandatory; no padding. The previous output was rejected because it had a 3:1 canvas with broad white bars. This new image must fix that and have no light or shadow relief.
